findings.location: Star rating indicators below each product image
findings.issue: The light yellow/gold used for the filled star ratings and the very light grey for empty stars both have extremely poor contrast against the white background, violating WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text/graphics).
findings.user_impact: Users with moderate visual impairments or those viewing the screen in high-glare environments will find it nearly impossible to distinguish the book ratings.
findings.recommendation: Change the color of the active yellow stars to a darker, high-contrast amber/orange hue (e.g., #C2410C or #D97706) and use a darker grey outline for the inactive stars.

findings.location: Breadcrumbs bar ('Home / All products') at the top of the main content area
findings.issue: The light grey text for 'Home' and '/ All products' against the very light grey background box does not meet the WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast ratio threshold.
findings.user_impact: Reduces navigational usability, making it difficult for users to quickly identify their current location in the site hierarchy.
findings.recommendation: Increase the text contrast by changing the font color of the breadcrumb links to a darker shade of grey (such as #4B5563 or #2D3748) against the light grey background block.

findings.location: Product title links in the main catalog grid
findings.issue: Book titles are severely truncated with trailing ellipses (e.g., 'A Light in the ...', 'Sapiens: A Brief History ...', 'The Dirty Little Secrets ...') even when there is ample vertical space below them, prioritizing a rigid single-line layout over content readability.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot scan or identify the actual titles of the books without hovering or clicking through to each individual detail page, drastically degrading catalog usability.
findings.recommendation: Allow product titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines with a defined container height, ensuring complete or near-complete titles are readable directly in the grid.
